page.overview:
Who is Charlie?

Charlie is a welfare worker in the 1971 film Diamonds Are Forever.

He and his partner are working in Nevada and fixing the tunnel cleaning machines.

One day, a machine broke down 500 yards from the nearest hatch. When Charlie opened the tunnel's door Bond came out and said : Thank you very much. I was walking my rat and seem to have lost my way.
